answer_1.quote: We conduct this investigation using the SummEval dataset, the largest corpus of English-language human annotated text summaries widely available. We translate this dataset from English to seven languages and evaluate the correlations between automated summary evaluation measures and human annotations.
answer_1.outputs: Machine-generated summaries and human reference summaries

answer_2.quote: we score machine-generated summaries with a few common or promising automated evaluation measures... We calculate the following truly automated... measures: Jensen-Shannon, ESTIME and BLANC. We also calculate the following reference-based automatic evaluation measures: BLEU, BERTScore-F1, and ROUGE as ROUGE-1,2,L.

answer_4.quote: Each machine-generated summary is annotated by three experts and five crowd workers using a five-point scale for four quality measures: coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Five-point scale for each quality measure
